summary: Gentor Resources Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing interim condensed consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports a net income of $577,300 driven by a $698,047 writeback of related party liability, offset by an operating loss. The company remains an exploration-stage entity with minimal cash ($10,235) and significant liabilities, including $718,484 due to related parties. No special-situation transaction is disclosed; this is a routine periodic report for a foreign private issuer.
